items.title: Gpt-image
items.summary:
Gpt-image
【角色】，保留核心发型轮廓、发色、瞳色与标志性身份配饰，将其造型与气质融入暗黑国风虐恋立绘体系中。

纯数字板绘，国风商业插画，柔和半厚涂质感（Soft Cel Shading / Semi-Realistic 2D）。
人物呈现极高明度、低饱和度的冷粉白瓷肌，面部与锁骨结构清晰纤细，运用大面积柔性喷枪过渡，边缘朦胧柔和；双眼微带下垂与泛红下眼睑，眼神克制哀戚，呈现脆弱而危险的受难破碎感。

服饰根据角色身份进行古风素雅轻薄衣衫重构，衣物与身躯留有斑驳的暗红朱砂血迹作为核心情绪跳色。

画面采用半身近景构图，双手被哑光粗重金属锁链紧紧束缚缠绕，与身后斑驳粗粝的深色木质刑架形成明确的受力、压制与接触关系。

背景为深青灰与铁锈暗调的密闭幽暗空间，一束冷白色戏剧性斜向束光（丁达尔强侧逆光）自上方切入，精准照亮人物发顶、面颊与胸前锁链反光，空气中漂浮微弱尘雾光晕，明暗交界柔和。

画面右侧约5%边缘保留极小小写 voxcat 签名，垂直布局，末尾一个青金石蓝小圆点。

items.title: A GPT 2.6 prompt for witty posters. Seems promising.
items.summary:
A GPT 2.6 prompt for witty posters. Seems promising. 

2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 AI picked topics: 
INPUT: $ SUBJECT

// ========================================================
// 1. SEMANTIC COMEDY ENGINE
// ========================================================

S = analyze($ SUBJECT)

DNA = {
    identity    : central_identity(S),
    personality : infer_comedic_personality(S),
    behaviors   : discover_typical_behaviors(S, count=5..12),
    conflicts   : identify_contradictions(S),
    props       : infer_relevant_objects(S, count=3..8),
    emotions    : infer_expressive_states(S),
    language    : natural_conversational_English
}

COMEDY = rank(
    relatable_observations(S)
    + unexpected_contradictions(S)
    + ironic_self_justifications(S)
    + playful_exaggerations(S),
    by = visual_potential * humor * clarity
)

Select the strongest concept with a clear visual payoff.

DO NOT invent random jokes unrelated to $ SUBJECT.

// ========================================================
// 2. CHARACTER TRANSLATION
// ========================================================

CHARACTER = transform(S.identity) into
    "simple expressive hand-inked cartoon mascot"

IF S is an animal:
    retain recognizable anatomy;
    exaggerate posture and facial expression;

ELIF S is an object:
    anthropomorphize its defining physical form;

ELIF S is a person or profession:
    construct a simplified expressive caricature;

ELIF S is abstract:
    embody the concept as an unexpected character
    or metaphorical creature;

ELSE:
    select the most visually recognizable agent.

CHARACTER_RULES = {
    silhouette       : chunky and instantly readable,
    proportions      : compact body, expressive face,
    outlines         : irregular thick black ink,
    eyes             : comedic focal point,
    hands_or_limbs   : gesture-driven,
    expression       : strongly tied to the punchline,
    textures         : sparse hatching and stippling,
    color            : primarily black and white
}

Personality must be visible WITHOUT reading the text.

// ========================================================
// 3. JOKE CONSTRUCTION
// ========================================================

Generate the following narrative logic:

SETUP =
    familiar statement or expectation about $ SUBJECT

ACTION =
    character behavior that apparently supports SETUP

TWIST =
    visual or textual contradiction

PUNCHLINE =
    concise surprising reinterpretation

COMEDIC_STRUCTURE =
    SETUP → FALSE CONFIDENCE → REVEAL → PUNCHLINE

Examples of structural relationships:

ambition       vs avoidance
confidence     vs incompetence
urgency        vs indifference
planning       vs execution
technology     vs human behavior
expectation    vs reality
seriousness    vs absurdity

Select relationships based on semantic relevance.

// ========================================================
// 4. ADAPTIVE LAYOUT
// ========================================================

LAYOUT = choose_by_message_complexity({

    short_joke:
        single vertical poster,

    sequential_humor:
        2x2 comic arrangement,

    before_after:
        two horizontally paired scenes,

    escalating_gag:
        three sequential panels,

    conversational_observation:
        one large mascot with surrounding statements
})

IF four_panel_comic:

    ┌──────────────────┬──────────────────┐
    │ BOLD SETUP       │ EXPECTATION      │
    │                  │                  │
    │   character      │   character      │
    │   + prop         │   + visual cue   │
    │                  │                  │
    │  small remark    │  ironic detail   │
    ├──────────────────┼──────────────────┤
    │ BEHAVIOR         │ FINAL REVEAL     │
    │                  │                  │
    │   escalating     │   expressive     │
    │   contradiction  │   character      │
    │                  │                  │
    │   caption        │ BIG PUNCHLINE    │
    └──────────────────┴──────────────────┘

Each panel must have a complete visual joke.

Do not repeat the exact same pose in every panel.

// ========================================================
// 5. TYPOGRAPHY AS COMEDIC ACTING
// ========================================================

TEXT = write_original_humorous_copy(COMEDY)

Typography hierarchy:

H1:
    enormous irregular hand-painted uppercase;
    thick rounded brush lettering;
    slightly inconsistent character widths;

H2:
    smaller casual handwritten sentence;

H3:
    huge dramatic punchline;
    visually emphatic words;

ACCENT:
    orange underline, checkmark, gesture,
    or one small relevant object.

RULES:

- Text must be grammatical and legible.
- Use natural humor, not generic motivational copy.
- The punchline must be immediately understandable.
- Emphasize 1–3 important words visually.
- Never fill the image with unnecessary paragraphs.

// ========================================================
// 6. COMEDIC PROP SYSTEM
// ========================================================

For every major behavior:

PROP = most_semantically_relevant_object(behavior)

Transform props into:
    simplified cartoon silhouettes,
    bold outlines,
    minimal internal details,
    occasional expressive faces.

Props may visually contradict the text.

For example, a promise of productivity can coexist
with visual evidence of doing absolutely nothing.

The scene must show the joke, not simply decorate it.

// ========================================================
// 7. PRINT STYLE
// ========================================================

PALETTE = {
    black       : #141414,
    white       : #FFFEFA,
    accent      : #F47725
}

BLACK = 85–95% of visible ink.
ACCENT = small selective emphasis.

SURFACE:
    imperfect marker ink,
    subtle screenprint grain,
    dry brush edges,
    organic line irregularities.

LIGHTING:
    none; illustration is flat printed artwork.

BACKGROUND:
    warm white or very pale cream.

COMPOSITION:
    generous white space;
    bold character silhouette;
    strong text-image rhythm.

// ========================================================
// 8. OUTPUT QUALITY ASSERTIONS
// ========================================================

ASSERT:
    subject_specific_humor == TRUE;
    character_is_expressive == TRUE;
    typography_is_dominant == TRUE;
    punchline_is_original == TRUE;
    mobile_thumbnail_readability == HIGH;
    excessive_detail == FALSE;

RENDER:
    A witty illustrated comic or poster about $ SUBJECT,
    combining hand-drawn character comedy,
    oversized expressive typography,
    minimal black ink, tiny orange accents,
    and a memorable visual punchline.

AVOID:
    generic stock cartoons,
    corporate vector art,
    photorealism,
    ordinary comic fonts,
    repetitive joke structures,
    unnecessary backgrounds,
    random props,
    irrelevant captions.

items.title: Google touts AI breakthrough, path to "unhackable" software
items.summary:
To test the system, researchers reintroduced two previously fixed bugs into Signal's code. In both cases, the AI-powered framework generated mathematical proofs showing that the altered software was insecure.

The intrigue: But Chaudhuri told Axios that the AI lab's tools were able to accomplish this feat in just four weeks — compared to the years it would've likely taken humans alone. [...] Driving the news:Google DeepMind said Tuesday it used AI agents powered by its Gemini 4 Carbon model to mathematically verify that the code underpinning Signal's encryption is secure.

   The agents generated more than 3 million lines of mathematical proofs in the process, allowing researchers to verify the software at a level of detail previously considered impractical. [...] Google DeepMind researchers have used AI to mathematically prove that the encryption code protecting billions of private messages works as intended.

Why it matters: The research breakthrough could eventually help defenders build better software. "You can finally get to this world of unhackable software," said Swarat Chaudhuri, a research scientist at Google DeepMind.

items.title: Cổ phiếu công nghệ Mỹ biến động trước lo ngại về quy định AI | NHK WORLD-JAPAN News
items.summary:
Một số chuyên gia cho rằng các công ty trung tm dữ liệu mới nổi có thể gặp khó khăn về vốn nếu các quy định chặt chẽ hơn làm chậm tiến độ các dự án xy dựng mới. Các công ty này đã dựa vào khoản vay để mở rộng kinh doanh.  
   
Nguồn tin thị trường cho biết điều đó có nghĩa là cổ phiếu công nghệ có thể vẫn bất ổn trong thời gian trước mắt. [...] Chiến thắng áp đảo của đảng Dn chủ trong cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ của Mỹ đã làm dấy lên lo ngại về triển vọng của ngành trí tuệ nhn tạo và bán dẫn. Điều này khiến cổ phiếu công nghệ cao của Mỹ biến động.  
   
Đảng Dn chủ đã giành lại quyền kiểm soát cả hai viện Quốc hội trong cuộc bầu cử tuần trước. Các ứng viên đảng Dn chủ cũng chiến thắng trong các cuộc bầu cử thống đốc ở nhiều bang, trong đó có Texas, nơi có nhiều trung tm dữ liệu. [...] Một số nhà đầu tư lo ngại những chiến thắng này có thể dẫn đến việc siết chặt quy định đối với AI và các trung tm dữ liệu.  
   
Mối lo này đã gy ra làn sóng bán tháo cổ phiếu bán dẫn và các cổ phiếu khác liên quan đến AI. Hôm thứ Năm, chỉ số Nasdaq gồm nhiều cổ phiếu công nghệ ở New York giảm hơn 5%. Cổ phiếu công nghệ đã phần nào khôi phục vào ngày hôm sau nhưng các nhà đầu tư vẫn thận trọng.

items.title: Sở Khoa học và Công nghệ Hà Tĩnh hướng dẫn xét công nhận sáng kiến và đánh giá hiệu quả đề tài khoa học
items.summary: Theo hướng dẫn, các giải pháp được xem xét công nhận là sáng kiến bao gồm: giải pháp kỹ thuật, giải pháp quản lý, giải pháp tác nghiệp và giải pháp ứng dụng tiến bộ kỹ thuật. Trong đó, giải pháp kỹ thuật có thể là sản phẩm, vật liệu, giống cy trồng, vật nuôi hoặc quy trình công nghệ; giải pháp quản lý là phương pháp tổ chức, điều hành công việc; giải pháp tác nghiệp là các phương pháp thực hiện nghiệp vụ chuyên môn; còn giải pháp ứng dụng tiến bộ kỹ thuật là việc áp dụng các giải pháp kỹ thuật [...] Đối với các đề tài khoa học, đề án khoa học và công trình khoa học – công nghệ, việc xét nghiệm thu thực hiện theo quy định của pháp luật về khoa học và công nghệ. Các đề tài chỉ được xem xét công nhận hiệu quả áp dụng và phạm vi ảnh hưởng khi đã được nghiệm thu đạt yêu cầu trở lên.

Trong khi đó, Blindsight hướng đến thiết lập đường dẫn thị giác nhn tạo, cho phép bệnh nhn dùng camera để thu thập hình ảnh, sau đó chuyển đổi tín hiệu thành dạng mà não bộ hiểu được thông qua [...] Dù không phải công ty đầu tiên nghiên cứu về giao diện não - máy tính, Neuralink là một trong những tên tuổi thành công nhất, phần nào nhờ hỗ trợ tài chính từ Musk. Một số doanh nghiệp khác cũng nỗ lực nghiên cứu công nghệ tương tự. Ví dụ, Meta phát triển máy quét điện não đồ từ trường không xm lấn cho phép người dùng chuyển suy nghĩ thành những thao tác nhấn phím, trong khi startup Trung Quốc NeuroXess, thành lập năm 2021, đang đẩy nhanh tiến độ để thử nghiệm trên người trong năm nay. [...] Neuralink đã tiến hành một số thử nghiệm công nghệ cho người bị tổn thương tủy sống, bệnh xơ cứng teo cơ một bên (ALS) và bệnh lý khác. Vài năm gần đy, công ty cũng công bố một số ca cấy ghép não. Hồi tháng 1, Neuralink cho biết có 21 người đã tham gia thử nghiệm trên toàn thế giới.

this is f*cking insane. andrej karpathy: "the biggest regret of every engineer in my field right now is every AI conversation they never saved, and in 10 years the ones who started saving in 2024 will be running circles around the rest of us"

andrej karpathy, co-founder of openai, pulled 16M views on one idea: stop using AI to write code, use it to build a second brain that remembers every article, pdf, transcript and conversation you ever fed it

you point claude code at a folder, drop anything into it, and claude reads it, cross-links it with everything already there, and writes it into a living wiki. your knowledge finally compounds instead of leaking out of your head every friday

the stack:

→ brew install obsidian, mkdir ~/vault, cd ~/vault
→ run claude in that folder and type "init a knowledge vault with CLAUDE.md as the rules, /raw for sources, /wiki for your pages"
→ drop any file into /raw (youtube transcript, meeting notes, 400-page pdf, screenshot of a tweet) and type "ingest"
→ claude writes a wiki page, links it to 5 existing ones automatically, updates CLAUDE.md with any new pattern it noticed about how you think
→ never open a blank claude chat again. every question goes through the vault, every answer cites your own sources with dates and links

5 minutes to set up. compounding knowledge from that evening forward

the ugly part most will scroll past: in 10 years the engineers who started this in 2024 will remember every book, every podcast, every meeting with receipts. you will remember none of them. karpathy already picked which side he is on and you are still not on his

Tôi là trợ lý nghiên cứu thông tin chuyên hỗ trợ tìm kiếm, tổng hợp và cập nhật tin tức, mạng xã hội và các bài viết trên web.

Dưới đây là những việc tôi có thể hỗ trợ bạn:
- **Tin tức & Web:** Tìm kiếm bài báo, tin tức thời sự và các nội dung mới nhất trên Internet (`lookup`, `fetch`).
- **Mạng xã hội (X/Twitter):** Theo dõi dòng thời gian (timeline) của một tài khoản cụ thể hoặc tìm kiếm các tweet thảo luận theo chủ đề (`timeline`, `social_search`).

- **Kiến thức tổng quan:** Tra cứu tóm tắt về nhân vật, khái niệm hoặc tổ chức qua Wikipedia (`wikipedia`).
- **Tổng hợp & Định dạng:** Lọc trùng, tóm tắt và trình bày thông tin thu thập được thành bản tin hoặc báo cáo rõ ràng.

items.title: New model helps robots learn tasks faster with less human programming
items.summary:
Called agentic robotics, the approach allows teams of AI agents to generate robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments, identify failures, and revise their code before deploying it on physical machines.

The technology could address two longstanding challenges in robotics: the extensive engineering required to program robot behaviors and the large volumes of real-world data needed to train robots through imitation learning. [...] Agentic robotics seeks to combine the advantages of these methods while reducing their limitations. The approach uses a framework called Graph-as-Policy, which divides complex robotic tasks into smaller, reusable skills. These include identifying objects, planning grasps, and moving robotic grippers without colliding with surrounding objects. [...] UC Berkeley researchers have developed an AI-driven approach that could significantly accelerate how robots are programmed and trained for real-world tasks. Called agentic robotics, the approach uses teams of AI agents to generate robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments, and refine their performance.

The method could reduce the need for extensive training data and manual engineering, two major challenges that have slowed the development of capable robots.

items.title: Robots could transform breast surgery forever | Vox
items.summary:
In a traditional mastectomy, the surgical cut is held physically open with instruments called retractors, which can cause considerable physical trauma and pressure in the area around it. By contrast, in robotic surgery, carbon dioxide gas is used to open up the space in a much gentler manner. Farr believes that reduced trauma to the skin and better visualization of structures (and hence increased ability to avoid critical nerves) in robot-assisted surgery could be the reason that some patients [...] In a robotic mastectomy, the surgeon sits at a console a few feet away from the patient and controls every movement of the machine’s instruments with their hands. The da Vinci single-port robot, the version cleared for nipple-sparing mastectomies, has one arm that enters the body through a single small incision usually along the side of the chest or, in some cases, in the fold beneath the breast. The arm has three multi-jointed instruments at one end, which the surgeon can use to bend, grasp, [...] Some surgeons are embracing this new technology because it offers a smaller, hidden scar and a clearer view inside the breast. Some patients also report better sensation in the chest area afterward.
 But critics say that there isn’t conclusive long-term evidence yet that robotic nipple-sparing mastectomies are as good as open mastectomies at making sure the cancer doesn’t come back, even if they are technically safe to perform.

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: OpenAI kicks off charm offensive to change voters' view of data centers | Reuters
items.summary:
SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 5 (Reuters) - Stunning ​victories by Democrats in US midterm elections this week have been interpreted by many as Americans repudiating tech ‌industry plans to build data centers across the country. OpenAI has now embarked on new strategies to change their minds.

The AI lab on Thursday laid out policies — in the works since August — intended to help the company build more trust with local communities and convince them that data centers will ​benefit them. [...] OpenAI officials, along with many of their peers in tech, ​have spent the last ⁠two years trying to build ties with the administration of US President Donald Trump in hopes of shaping federal policy around AI.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman donated $1 million to Trump's inaugural committee and later attended Trump's second inauguration. Last year, Brockman donated $25 million in his personal capacity to ⁠a Trump ​super PAC. [...] The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here.

OpenAI said it will no longer use non-disclosure agreements with public officials when negotiating or discussing future sites, although ​proprietary information would still be under wraps. It will also give residents access to construction plans ⁠and their potential effect on traffic, noise and lighting.

items.title: OpenAI employees warned about operational security lapses for years, sources say | Reuters
items.summary:
OpenAI and Anthropic have tried to ​maintain a more open research culture to both ⁠attract employees and foster creativity that can lead to breakthroughs. The AI field is rooted in academia, where machine-learning scientists have openly discussed their research.

Some OpenAI employees are increasingly worried about this approach as AI grows more capable, according to the five people. [...] When asked about employees' concerns and their view that management did not act on these issues, OpenAI spokesperson Elana Widmann ​said that OpenAI is one of the most targeted organizations in the world. As a result, the company invests heavily in its security program to protect against attacks from insiders, cybercriminals and nation-states, she said. [...] The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here.

These workers argued that OpenAI's controls were so lax ‌that outsiders, including foreign governments, could obtain sensitive information about the AI lab's technology with relative ease, the people said. For example, anybody at OpenAI who could access its code could see the technical details underlying many company projects.
